input_data_status.assumed_or_experimental: demand duty/profile, conveyance and application efficiency, source/group derating, restrictions, control normalization and recourse budgets
input_data_status.derived: path connectors; WRLU centroid assignment; active irrigated area; application-efficiency aggregation; period volume conversion
input_data_status.observed_or_directly_joined: network nodes/path relations; service-area identity; WRLU attributes; exact-name canal MaxCFS
input_data_status.proxy: Distribution Network RelativeSize where no exact MaxCFS join exists

scientific_scope.claimant_definition: each F element is an irrigation-company service area, not an individual farmer
scientific_scope.does_not_validate: individual-farmer fairness, observed 2025 source availability, or calibrated conveyance losses
scientific_scope.supports: real path-based DAG routing, claimant-terminal aggregation, gross/net delivery, shared source envelopes, operational recourse and stress experiments
